opening: Your Atmos stack with three components, and choudoufu as the binary. This first act edits all three, with every value known at plan. A new subnet comes in the second.

pull-request.status: Opening a pull request; its workflow runs Atmos's affected plan with dependents

planned.reply: One plan across 3 components. Every value is known at plan, so each card shows before and after: {creates} to create, {updates} to change.

approved.status: Recording your approval as a review on the pull request

merged.prompt: Merge it. Apply network, app and edge in order, each exactly as I reviewed it.
merged.status: Fetching the stored plans after the merge

applying.status: Deploying network, app and edge from their stored plans

tips.title: Only the binary changes
tips.body: Set the component command to choudoufu and give each component a live block. Nothing else in the repo moves.

tips.title: Stored plans, applied in order
tips.body: Atmos's deploy compares a fresh plan with each stored one before applying it. choudoufu stops any component whose plan has moved away from your review.

applied.reply: Done. Each component ran its approved plan, and both ports changed in network, app and edge, in that order.

closing: 1 plan across 3 components, and the one you approved is the one deployed.
